structuredContent.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage. The draft recommends a host-managed transaction per export, with subprocesses as the compatibility baseline, WASM as an opt-in path, and in-process converters limited to trusted code. It rejects treating exit status plus a path list as proof of complete, transferred output, and rejects version-range compatibility as proof that saved presets retain their meaning. The cited Pandoc release history documents output and behavior changes; the LSP specification treats cancellation as a request that still needs a response. ([Pandoc releases](https://pandoc.org/releases.html), [LSP 3.17](https://microsoft.github.io/language-server-protocol/specifications/lsp/3.17/specification/))
